meta.title: Master Services Agreement (MSA) Template (Free) | Workmatic
meta.description: Download a free Master Services Agreement template. Professional starting-point MSA for ongoing service relationships. Covers scope, fees, SLA, IP, liability, termination, and change orders.

subtitle: A professional starting-point template for ongoing service relationships. Covers scope, fees, service levels, IP ownership, liability caps, termination, and change order process.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Scope & Statement of Work
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: MSA governs the relationship; each project is a separate SOW. Ensure SOWs incorporate MSA terms and define deliverables, timeline, acceptance criteria.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Fees & Payment
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: Define rate card, invoicing frequency, payment terms (Net 15-30), late fees. Address expense reimbursement with caps and pre-approval.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Service Levels (SLA)
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: Define uptime, response times, resolution times, credits for misses. Keep SLAs measurable and tied to specific services.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Intellectual Property
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: Client owns deliverables; Provider retains methodology/tools. Critical distinction for repeatable service providers.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Liability Cap
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: Cap at fees paid (12 months). Carve-outs for IP, confidentiality, data breach, fraud. Watch for uncapped indemnity.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Term & Termination
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: MSA term vs. SOW term. Termination for convenience (30-90 days). Termination for cause with cure period. Effect on active SOWs.

key_clauses_to_watch.title: Change Orders
key_clauses_to_watch.why_it_matters: Formal process for scope changes. Written, signed, with fee/timeline impact. Prevents scope creep.

faq.question: MSA vs SOW
faq.answer: MSA = master terms governing the relationship (legal, IP, liability, termination). SOW = project-specific scope, timeline, deliverables, fees. You sign one MSA, then multiple SOWs under it.

faq.question: MSA for SaaS
faq.answer: This template is for professional/managed services. SaaS agreements need different terms: subscription fees, uptime SLA, data processing addendum, feature roadmap disclaimers. Use a SaaS-specific template for software subscriptions.

faq.question: Liability cap
faq.answer: Standard: 1x annual fees or fees paid in prior 12 months. Carve-outs: IP infringement, confidentiality breach, data protection violations, fraud/willful misconduct, indemnification obligations. Never accept unlimited liability.

faq.question: Active SOWs on termination
faq.answer: Typically: active SOWs continue until completion or separate termination. MSA termination does not auto-terminate SOWs unless specified. Define transition obligations (knowledge transfer, data return).
